leads.name: QB attempts UNDER vs the 8 worst pass D
leads.rule: Bet the under when the book's attempts line is 3+ above the trimmed average (drop the highest and lowest game) of starters vs those defenses.

leads.name: RB rushing yards vs the 8 worst run D
leads.rule: Trimmed carries x blended yards per carry; bet when it disagrees with the line by 10+ yards. Overs only count when the line is 60+.

leads.name: WR receiving yards / receptions
leads.rule: Target share and raw recent-target methods.
leads.backtest: Lost in ~380 bets; target methods failed the 2026 check
